Prismatic Evolutions

Released January 17, 2025 · 180 cards

StandardExpanded

Prismatic Evolutions is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on January 17, 2025. Its main set has 131 cards, plus 49 secret rares numbered beyond the set (180 in total). It includes 123 Pokémon, 57 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
